item.description: The US said Operation Epic Fury concluded after Iran violated a ceasefire. US-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: Day after ceasefire violation by Iran, US says Operation Epic Fury concluded The Times of India.

item.title: Crunch time for Capitals after latest loss dampens playoffs hopes
item.description: The Capitals' playoffs hopes are dampened after their latest loss. Crunch time for Capitals after latest loss dampens playoffs hopes.

item.title: US urges China to help reopen strait of Hormuz as Trump-Xi meeting nears
item.description: The US urged China to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz. US urges China to help reopen strait of Hormuz as Trump-Xi meeting nears.

item.title: Iran’s Araghchi holds talks with China’s Wang Yi in Beijing
item.description: Iran's Araghchi held talks with China's Wang Yi in Beijing. Iran's foreign minister meets his Chinese counterpart one week before President Donald Trump's visit to Beijing. Iran’s Araghchi holds talks with China’s Wang Yi in Beijing.

item.title: To stay or risk the 'Road of Death'
item.description: People in Oleshky are cut off from food and medicine supplies. People in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky say they have been cut off from fresh supplies of food or medicine for months.

item.title: US Unveiled Plan To Reopen Hormuz Hours Before Trump Shelved It
item.description: The US planned to reopen the Strait of Hormuz with "Project Freedom" before President Trump put it on hold. The initiative was part of the US strategy to counter Iran. The plan was shelved hours before its unveiling.

item.title: Companies Must "Reconceptualise Work" In AI Era: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
item.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said companies must adapt to AI by reconceptualizing work. Most organizations aren't built to fully utilize AI benefits, Microsoft said. Nadella emphasized the need to harness AI as an "expanded human ability".

item.title: Thai Foreign Minister seeks ASEAN talks with Myanmar counterpart
item.description: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow sought ASEAN talks with Myanmar's counterpart to restore engagement. He aimed to reestablish communication with Myanmar's leadership, including at the foreign minister level. The move aimed to revive diplomatic ties.

item.title: Trump says pausing Hormuz operation in push for Iran deal
item.description: President Trump paused "Project Freedom", a Hormuz operation, to push for an Iran deal. The pause came after a request from mediator Pakistan and other countries. Trump reported "Great Progress" toward a complete agreement with Tehran.

item.title: Cambodian PM's cousin says owned 30% of scam-linked firm
item.description: Cambodian PM's cousin claimed ownership of 30% of a firm linked to scams. The company was allegedly involved in scam operations. The cousin's statement sparked concerns about the PM's potential connections to the firm.

item.title: Philippines urges Myanmar to grant ASEAN envoy access to Aung San Suu Kyi
item.description: Philippines urged Myanmar to grant ASEAN envoy access to Aung San Suu Kyi, citing support for inclusive national dialogue. The Philippines said this would advance engagement with all stakeholders. The Philippines said access for ASEAN's special envoy would support engagement with all stakeholders and advance inclusive national dialogue.

item.title: Romania’s pro-EU government ousted after no-confidence vote
item.description: Romania's pro-EU government collapsed after a no-confidence vote. Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan's coalition lost the vote. The pro-European Union coalition of Romanian Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan has collapsed after a vote of no confidence.

item.title: Russia kills 27 in ‘senseless’ strikes on Ukraine days before ceasefire
item.description: Russia killed 27 people in strikes on Ukraine days before a planned ceasefire. The attacks were described as senseless. Russia kills 27 in ‘senseless’ strikes on Ukraine days before ceasefire Al Jazeera.

item.title: Ukraine reports strike as Kyiv's ceasefire due to begin
item.description: Ukraine reported a strike as a ceasefire was set to begin in Kyiv. The attack occurred despite the planned truce. Ukraine reports strike as Kyiv's ceasefire due to begin Newsbug. info.

item.title: US pauses plan to guide ships through the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US military operation guiding ships through the Strait of Hormuz was paused by Donald Trump. Donald Trump has said that the US military operation guiding ships through the Strait of Hormuz will be paused.

item.title: U.S. Military strike on alleged drug boat kills three in the eastern Pacific
item.description: A U. S. military strike on an alleged drug boat in the eastern Pacific killed three people. The strike is part of the U. S. effort to stem the flow of drugs into the country and reduce fatal overdoses.

item.title: On Pakistan's Request, Trump Briefly Pauses Project Freedom, Blockade To Continue
item.description: The U. S. briefly paused Project Freedom and a blockade at Pakistan's request. Senator Marco Rubio mentioned a ceasefire in the Middle East was still in place. Marco Rubio said a ceasefire in the Middle East was still in place.

item.title: Putin Living In Bunkers As Kremlin Fears Drones, Coups And Assassination: Report
item.description: Russian President Putin is reportedly spending extended periods in underground bunkers due to concerns about drone attacks, coups, and assassination attempts. The Kremlin has not confirmed the reports. Russian President Vladimir Putin is reportedly spending extended periods in underground bunkers.

item.title: U.S.-Iran ceasefire holding for now, Hegseth says, as Trump looks to finalize deal
item.description: A US-Iran ceasefire is currently holding, according to Hegseth, as Trump looks to finalize a deal. The ceasefire has been in place for several days, but its long-term prospects remain uncertain.
